artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a faint reddish/orange glow or reflection on the lower right side of the cup's exterior. While this could be a reflection from the warm background lights or the cookie, it appears slightly diffuse and inconsistent with the sharp specular highlights elsewhere, suggesting minor AI blending or lighting inconsistency.

The cookie lacks a coherent crumb structure. It appears as a fused, muddy mass of brown texture without distinct edges or realistic porosity, typical of AI-generated food items where fine detail collapses.
